type Result<T, E> = { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T } | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
const brand: unique symbol = Symbol("Model");
export type Model = { readonly [brand]: true; readonly value: number; increment(): Result<void, "limit"> };
export const Model = {
  create(initial: number): Result<Model, "invalid"> {
    if (initial < 0) return { ok: false, error: "invalid" };
    const state = { value: initial };
    const instance: Model = {
      [brand]: true, value: state.value,
      increment() { state.value++; return { ok: true, value: undefined }; },
    };
    return { ok: true, value: instance };
  },
};
